note: What the creatures do, the routes through this place, and what a Remix may change.

encounters.name: The remembered steward

locked: Revelation: The champion resembles figures and choices within royal memory, but the memories address him as 'you who came,' never 'you who returned.'
Route-key: Assemble a truthful sequence of resonant memories rather than the most flattering sequence.
open: The voices in the hall speak of a figure who made the same choices the champion has made; the resemblance is real, the conclusion is the party's.
Kaelra names the alcoves' scenes in the most flattering order (EC-MP-03); the stair's notes give the true one (EC-MP-04).

original.does: The 'remembered steward': wears faces from the hall's memories, reads thoughts, then wears the face of someone the party trusts.
Remembered shapes that peel from the steward statues and drain strength.

difficulty.tuner_recommends: as built (plays as moderate); not applied unless the map says so

rewards: shadows that hide in dim light

may_change: the read-aloud and GM lines about them
must_keep: a steward who wears remembered and trusted faces
the voices addressing the champion as 'you who came', never 'you who returned'
the measured difficulty (plays as moderate, or the GM's target)
remix.freshness: a remix for returning players avoids the Doppelganger and Shadows

not_simulated: Doppelganger: Read Thoughts and Shape-Shift (the GM's)
Shadow: Strength Drain is played; hiding in dim light is the GM's

routes.when: The steward wears a trusted face and speaks; a character plays along to draw out what it wants.
routes.success: The doppelganger, pleased with its mask, tells the party what the hall wants: a sequence. It offers the flattering one, and lets them pass to the alcoves to 'find their story'. The shadows stay on the statues.
routes.failure: It reads the lie in their thoughts, drops the face and strikes; the shadows peel free.
lines: The remembered steward, in a trusted voice: 'You who came. Of course it was you. Put your choices first, and the road will open.'
routes.reveals: The steward always says 'you who came'; it has never said 'returned'.
routes.canon: Delivers the revelation and tempts the party toward the flattering sequence.

routes.when: A character recognises that the trusted face knows something its owner cannot know.
routes.success: Named for what it is, the steward laughs and becomes a statue's face again; the shadows fold back. It will not fight those it cannot fool.
routes.failure: The face is believed; the steward strikes when backs are turned.
routes.reveals: The steward is made of the hall's memories: it can only show what was, never what it means.
routes.canon: Fair play: the memories are true; the conclusion is the party's.
